name: analyze_contract_security
description: Analyzes smart contracts for security vulnerabilities, including checks for common patterns associated with known vulnerabilities such as reentrancy, overflow/underflow, and unhandled exceptions.

code.description: The Solidity smart contract code to analyze.

language.description: The programming language of the smart contract.

version.description: The compiler version used for the smart contract.

name: assess_permissioning
description: Assesses the permissioning and access control mechanisms of a smart contract to ensure only authorized entities can execute certain functions or access specific data.

code.description: The Solidity smart contract code to assess for permissioning.

analysis_type.description: The type of analysis to perform on the smart contract code.

name: audit_transaction_flow
description: Analyzes the flow of transactions within a smart contract to identify any potential bottlenecks or security vulnerabilities such as reentrancy or front-running.

code.description: The Solidity smart contract code to audit for transaction flow.

analysis_depth.description: Depth of the transaction flow analysis.

name: check_gas_optimization
description: Evaluates the gas efficiency of smart contract functions and suggests optimizations to reduce transaction costs.

contract_code.description: The source code of the smart contract in Solidity.

optimization_level.description: The level of gas optimization analysis to perform.

name: detect_reentrancy
description: Detect potential reentrancy vulnerabilities in smart contract functions that could lead to security breaches.

contract_code.description: The full Solidity source code of the smart contract to be analyzed for reentrancy vulnerabilities.

analysis_depth.description: The depth of analysis to perform; 'Shallow' for quick checks or 'Deep' for comprehensive analysis.

name: evaluate_oracle_integrity
description: Evaluate the integrity and trustworthiness of oracles used within a smart contract.

contract_code.description: The Solidity code of the smart contract using oracles.

oracle_addresses.description: A list of oracle contract addresses to be evaluated for integrity checks.

name: simulate_contract_behavior
description: Simulate the behavior of a smart contract under various conditions and inputs.

contract_code.description: The complete code of the smart contract to be simulated.

simulation_scenarios.description: A collection of scenarios, each with a unique set of transactions and initial states, to simulate.

name: test_smart_contract
description: Execute a series of tests on a smart contract to ensure it behaves as expected.

test_cases.description: A series of test cases with defined inputs and expected outputs to validate contract behavior.

name: validate_contract_compliance
description: Validate if the smart contract complies with standard security protocols and best practices in the blockchain industry.

contract_code.description: The full smart contract code to be analyzed for compliance.

compliance_standards.description: A set of compliance standards or guidelines that the contract should adhere to.

blockchain_platform.description: The blockchain platform for which the contract is written (e.g., Ethereum, Solana).

name: verify_signature
description: Verifies the digital signature of a message or transaction to ensure its authenticity and integrity.

message.description: The original message or transaction data that was signed.

signature.description: The digital signature that needs to be verified.

public_key.description: The public key of the signer used to verify the signature.

signature_algorithm.description: The algorithm used for signing and verification.
